ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p426/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p426/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p426/r3.claim: Since God’s wisdom and justice will ultimately manifest, the Prophet should ignore deniers of resurrection who imagine they would keep the same favors if it came.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p426/r3.anchor: This world is not revolving around their desires; it has been created by a wise and powerful being

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p426/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p426/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p426/r4.claim: The word iṭāʿah here means being affected or influenced, a usage found in both Qur’anic and classical Arabic.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p426/r4.anchor: It is used in this sense in both the Qur’ān and in classical Arabic.

QUSHAYRI:v3p342/r2.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p342/r2.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p342/r2.claim: Because the worshiped One is one, the believer's aim and witnessed goal should also be one.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r4.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r4.claim: The Prophet is forbidden to obey those who deny God's revelation or their invitations to venerate idols.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p237/r4.anchor: أي الذين كذبوا بما أنزل الله عليك من الوحي،

TABATABAI:68:1-33#2/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:68:1-33#2/r4.speaker: author
TABATABAI:68:1-33#2/r4.claim: The prohibition on obeying the deniers follows from their being astray; obedience includes agreeing with them in speech or action.
TABATABAI:68:1-33#2/r4.anchor: والمراد بالطاعة مطلق الموافقة عملا أو قولا

ELMALILI:68:7-33#2/r3.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:68:7-33#2/r3.speaker: author
ELMALILI:68:7-33#2/r3.claim: The Prophet must not heed, obey, or follow the false path proposed by deniers, but must persist in his mission despite their injustice and rebellion; the admonition also extends to all rational people.
ELMALILI:68:7-33#2/r3.anchor: münkirleri dinleme, tanıma, sözlerini tutma, sevketmek istedikleri yanlış yola gitme

ELMALILI:68:7-33#2/r4.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:68:7-33#2/r4.speaker: author
ELMALILI:68:7-33#2/r4.claim: The consequence-marking fa introduces the first practical result of the preceding assurances and the opening counsel for carrying out God's mission.
ELMALILI:68:7-33#2/r4.anchor: Fâ-i cezâiyenin delâletiyle yukarıki te’mînâtın ilk neticesi olan bu nehiy

ELMALILI:68:7-33#2/r5.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:68:7-33#2/r5.speaker: author
ELMALILI:68:7-33#2/r5.claim: Generosity and forbearance are virtues only when they do not promote injustice or compromise; true generosity lies in purity, sincerity, courage, and patiently teaching their outcomes.
ELMALILI:68:7-33#2/r5.anchor: hilim, kerem ve semâhat, haksızlığı tervicde, ciddiyetsizlikte, müdahenede değil

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p591/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p591/r2.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p591/r2.claim: The command not to obey the deniers incites firm resistance; they had tried to persuade the Prophet to worship God for a time and their idols for a time in return for leaving him unharmed.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p591/r2.anchor: وكانوا قد أرادوه على أن يعبد الله مدة ، وآلهتهم مدة

TABRISI:68:1-16#4/r7.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:68:1-16#4/r7.speaker: author
TABRISI:68:1-16#4/r7.claim: The Prophet must not obey people who deny God's oneness and his prophethood or grant their requests.
TABRISI:68:1-16#4/r7.anchor: بتوحيد الله عز وجل الجاحدين لنبوتك ولا تجبهم إلى ما يلتمسون منك

RAZI-FULL:v30p73#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p73#2/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p73#2/r1.claim: After contrasting the disbelievers’ charge of madness with the Prophet’s religious and moral excellence, the sura urges firmness despite his few supporters and their many numbers.
RAZI-FULL:v30p73#2/r1.anchor: لما ذكر ما عليه الكفار في أمر الرسول ونسبته إلى الجنون مع الذي أنعم الله به عليه من الكمال

RAZI-FULL:v30p73#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p73#2/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p73#2/r2.claim: The deniers are the chiefs of Mecca, who invited Muhammad to follow his forefathers’ religion; the prohibition incites him to oppose them firmly, and this was among the sura’s earliest revelations.
RAZI-FULL:v30p73#2/r2.anchor: وذلك أنهم دعوه إلى دين آبائه

STUDYQURAN:68:8/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:68:8/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:68:8/r1.claim: The deniers are the Makkan disbelievers who urged the Prophet and his followers to follow their forefathers’ religion instead of the revelation.
STUDYQURAN:68:8/r1.anchor: The deniers refers to the Makkan disbelievers who were bidding the Prophet and his followers to follow the religion of their forefathers

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r1.claim: The deniers are Meccan leaders who invited the Prophet to adopt their religion; God forbids him to obey them.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p79/r1.anchor: يعني رؤساء أهل مكة، وذلك أنهم دعوه إلى دين

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:68:4-15/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:68:4-15/r4.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:68:4-15/r4.claim: Muhammad must not follow the deniers in what they call him to concerning their religion.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:68:4-15/r4.anchor: { فلا تطع المكذبين } فيما دعوك إليه من دينهم.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:68:8/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:68:8/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:68:8/r1.claim: Addressing all believers through the Prophet, the verse tells them not to yield to those who call him a liar and deny the truth.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:68:8/r1.anchor: Resûlullah’ın şahsında bütün müminlere hitap edilerek peygamberi yalancılıkla itham eden ve hakkı yalan sayanlara boyun eğmemeleri

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:68:8/r4.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:68:8/r4.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:68:8/r4.claim: God requires the Prophet to remain firm without slackening: God's path is right, and truth cannot be mixed with falsehood.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:68:8/r4.anchor: Hz. Peygamber’in tâvizsiz davranmasını, gevşeklik göstermemesini istemektedir. Zira doğru yol O’nun yoludur ve hak ile bâtıl birbirine karıştırılamaz

BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p161/r1.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p161/r1.speaker: author
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p161/r1.claim: The opening verses affirm the Prophet’s mission and steady him against deniers who dispute the miracle and claim the Qur’an is merely tales of the ancients.
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p161/r1.anchor: واضح أن الآيات موجهه إلى تأييد نبوة المصطفى عليه الصلاة والسلام، تثبيت قلبه في مواجهة من يكذبونه

ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#2/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#2/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#2/r1.claim: The ف orders noncompliance as a consequence of the Prophet’s guidance and their misguidance, or of all the preceding material in the surah.

ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#2/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#2/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#2/r2.claim: The command exhorts the Prophet to remain firm in refusing them and to intensify that stance.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#2/r2.anchor: وهذا تهييج وإلهاب للتصميم على معاصاتهم أي دم على ما أنت عليه من عدم طاعتهم وتصلب في ذلك

ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#2/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#2/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#2/r3.claim: Another possibility is that the prohibition targets ingratiating compromise—outwardly displaying something contrary to the Prophet’s conviction to win their hearts—rather than literal obedience.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p26#2/r3.anchor: وجوز أن يكون نهيا عن مداهنتهم ومداراتهم بإظهار خلاف ما في ضميره

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p192/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p192/r1.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p192/r1.claim: The deniers are Meccan polytheists who invited the Prophet to follow his forefathers' religion; God forbade him to obey them.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p192/r1.anchor: يعني مشركي مكة فإنهم كانوا يدعونه إلى دين آبائه فنهاه أن يطيعهم

BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r3.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r3.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r3.claim: The prohibition urges firm resolve to oppose the deniers.
BAYDAWI-FULL:68:7-10/r3.anchor: { فلا تطع المكذبين } تهييج للتصميم على معاصاتهم

BINTSHATI:v2p54/r6.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p54/r6.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v2p54/r6.claim: The deniers here reject God's signs and the prophethood of His messenger.
BINTSHATI:v2p54/r6.anchor: التكذيب هنا، بآيات الله ونبوة رسوله عليه الصلاة والسلام

BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r5.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r5.claim: The command addresses Muhammad but intends his community, urging steadfastness when persecution might tempt even a sensible person to compromise.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r5.anchor: وهو خطاب له صلى الله عليه وسلم والمراد أمته ليكون ذلك أبلغ في سماعهم

BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r6.speaker: الملوي
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r6.claim: Al-Malwī says denial corrupts the intellectual and speaking faculties and is the root of every unbelief, deviation, innovation, and evil.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p99/r6.anchor: قال الملوي : ولا يخفى أن كل كفر ظهر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r1.claim: The preceding praise of the Prophet and his guidance prepares the transition to the command not to obey the deniers.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r1.anchor: تمهيد وتوطئة لقوله : { فلا تطع المكذبين } ( القلم : 8 )

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r2.claim: The command follows from 68:7: since the Prophet is guided and the other side is astray, he must not yield to their hostility toward truth but answer firmly.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r2.anchor: تفريع على جملة { إن ربك هو أعلم بمن ضل عن سبيله } ( القلم : 7 ) إلى آخرها

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r6.speaker: كتب السيرة
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r6.claim: Sira books say the polytheists made the Prophet such an offer through his uncle Abū Ṭālib and ʿUtba ibn Rabīʿa.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r6.anchor: وورد في كتب السيرة أن المشركين تقدموا للنبيء صلى الله عليه وسلم بمثل هذا العرض ووسطوا في ذلك عمه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r7.claim: The offer followed the opening verses’ warning: they could stop calling him mad if he stopped humiliating their idols and forebears, leaving each side to its worship.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r7.anchor: فينتظم من هذا أن قوله { فلا تطع المكذبين } نهي عن إجابتهم إلى شيء عرضوه عليه عندما قرعهم بأول هذه السورة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r8.claim: Obedience is accepting an action someone seeks; under negation, the verb prohibits every kind of compliance with their requests.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r8.anchor: والطاعة : قبول ما يبتغى عمله ، ووقوع فعل { تطع } في حيز النهي

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r9.claim: Here obedience means conciliation and gentleness toward the deniers, as in the command not to obey disbelievers while striving against them.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p68/r9.anchor: فالطاعة مراد بها هنا المصالحة والملاينة كما في قوله تعالى : { فلا تطع الكافرين وجاهدهم به جهادا كبيرا }

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r1.claim: Calling them “the deniers” signals why obedience is forbidden: they have denied the Prophet’s mission.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p69/r1.anchor: واختير تعريفهم بوصف المكذبين دون غيره من طرق التعريف لأنه بمنزلة الموصول

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r18.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r18.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r18.claim: The command not to obey the deniers refers to Quraysh, who proposed worshipping one another’s deities as a bargain.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r18.anchor: وقوله تعالى: فلا تطع المكذبين يريد قريشا، وذلك أنهم قالوا في بعض الأوقات لرسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: لو عبدت آلهتنا

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#2/r1.claim: Meccan leaders invited the Prophet to follow his forefathers' religion, so God forbade him to obey them.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p330#2/r1.anchor: وذلك أن رؤساء أهل مكة دعوه إلى دين آبائه فنهاه الله أن يطيعهم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p190#2/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p190#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p190#2/r1.claim: Since God favored the Prophet with upright law and magnificent character, he must not obey the deniers.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p190#2/r1.anchor: كما أنعمنا عليك وأعطيناك الشرع المستقيم والخلق العظيم

MUQATIL:68:7-12/r2.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:68:7-12/r2.speaker: author
MUQATIL:68:7-12/r2.claim: The Prophet must not obey the deniers when they call him to his fathers’ religion and community.
MUQATIL:68:7-12/r2.anchor: حين دعى إلى دين آبائه وملتهم، نظيرها في سورة الفرقان

MUQATIL:68:7-12/r3.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:68:7-12/r3.speaker: author
MUQATIL:68:7-12/r3.claim: The verse was revealed concerning the Banu al-Mughira, including al-Walid, Abu Qays, Abd Allah b. Abi Umayya, and other named members of the clan.
MUQATIL:68:7-12/r3.anchor: نزلت هذه الآية في بني المغيرة بن عبدالله بن عمرو بن مخزوم، منهم الوليد بن المغيرة

NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#7/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#7/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#7/r1.claim: The command urges firm resolve to oppose the deniers; they wanted God worshipped for a time and their idols for a time, while they spared him harm.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#7/r1.anchor: تهيج للتصميم على معاصاتهم وقد أرادوا أن يعبد الله مدة وآلهتهم مدة

NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#7/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#7/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#7/r2.claim: The deniers proposed alternating worship and protection from their attacks as terms for compromise.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#7/r2.anchor: أن يعبد الله مدة وآلهتهم مدة ويكفوا عنه غوائلهم

QURTUBI-FULL:68:8/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:8/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:68:8/r1.claim: God forbids the Prophet to accommodate the polytheists, who offered to stop opposing him if he stopped opposing them; such accommodation would be disbelief.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:8/r1.anchor: نهاه عن ممايلة المشركين وكانوا يدعونه إلى أن يكف عنهم ليكفوا عنه، فبين الله تعالى أن ممايلتهم كفر.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:8/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:8/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:68:8/r2.claim: The warning recalls God's statement that He nearly let the Prophet incline slightly toward them had He not made him firm.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:8/r2.anchor: وقال تعالى: ولولا أن ثبتناك لقد كدت تركن إليهم شيئا قليلا

QURTUBI-FULL:68:8/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:8/r3.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:68:8/r3.claim: One reported explanation is that Quraysh's polytheists asked the Prophet to follow their corrupt ancestral religion, and he must not obey.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:8/r3.anchor: وقيل: أي فلا تطع المكذبين فيما دعوك إليه من دينهم الخبيث. نزلت في مشركي قريش حين دعوه إلى دين آبائه.
